name: Collector
description: Grab every coin to clear. Pays x1.25.
_help: minimum: every stage gets at least this many coins (extras are added on safe ground when the level pieces bring too few). An objective twist: it changes how you win, not how you move. objective "collect": in the platformer and brawler the exit stays locked until every coin is picked up; in the shmup a coin that leaves the screen costs a life. payout multiplies the stage tokens of a run you win, like Sudden Death.
